prompt:
Redesign the Kodak logo for a contemporary digital age.

Design goals:
- Modern, clean, minimalistic visual appearance
- Maintain recognizable connections to Kodak's heritage
- Incorporate red and yellow into the identity
- Suitable for digital applications and app icons
- Visually balanced, distinctive, and legible

Technical requirements:
- Generate a complete, standalone SVG
- Include a viewBox
- Use vector elements only
- No external images, fonts, or dependencies
- The design should remain recognizable at small sizes

criteria.title: Valid SVG Structure
criteria.description: The response is a complete, standalone SVG document with an svg root, xmlns namespace declaration, and a viewBox attribute.

candidates.source: The response contains a single root <svg> element that wraps all SVG content, with no extraneous text, markdown fences, or commentary before or after it.
The <svg> root element explicitly declares the xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" namespace attribute.
The <svg> root element includes a viewBox attribute with four numeric values that define a valid, non-zero rendering area.

criteria.title: Vector-Only Content
criteria.description: The design uses only native vector elements (paths, shapes, basic shapes) with no raster images, external fonts, stylesheets, scripts, or network dependencies.

candidates.source: The SVG source contains no <image> elements, no base64-encoded data URIs, and no raster graphics of any kind.
The SVG source uses only vector drawing primitives (such as path, rect, circle, ellipse, line, polygon, polyline, text) to construct the logo, with no embedded bitmap content.

The SVG source contains absolutely no references to external files, fonts, stylesheets, scripts, or network resources (e.g., no <link>, <script>, @import, href to external URLs, or @font-face declarations), and every visual element is defined natively within the SVG using vector shapes.

criteria.title: Self-Contained Styling
criteria.description: All styling is applied inline or via SVG presentation attributes rather than relying on external or linked resources.

candidates.source: The SVG source contains no <link>, <style src>, @import, or <?xml-stylesheet?> references to external stylesheets.

All visual styling (fill, stroke, font, color, etc.) is applied directly via inline style attributes or SVG presentation attributes on individual elements, with no reliance on a separate <style> block or CSS classes.

The SVG does not reference any external resources (e.g., fonts via url(), images via href/xlink:href to external files, or scripts) anywhere in the document, ensuring complete visual and structural self-containment.

criteria.title: Red and Yellow Incorporated
criteria.description: The design visibly incorporates both red and yellow as core identity colors.

candidates.source: The rendered screenshot shows at least one shape filled with a clearly red hue and at least one shape filled with a clearly yellow hue somewhere in the logo design.

The SVG source and rendered screenshot both demonstrate that red and yellow are used as prominent, deliberate fill or stroke colors on primary logo elements, not merely as minor or incidental accents.
Red and yellow are used so centrally and harmoniously in the design that they function as the defining color identity of the logo, with no other color visually competing for dominance.

criteria.title: Kodak Heritage Reference
criteria.description: The design retains a recognizable connection to Kodak's heritage, such as a K-mark motif or the Kodak wordmark shape language.

candidates.source: The SVG includes some visual element—such as a stylized "K" mark, badge/shield shape, or wordmark—that plausibly references Kodak's historic branding.

The rendered screenshot shows a design element clearly evocative of Kodak's heritage, such as a recognizable "K" monogram, a red-and-yellow badge reminiscent of the classic Kodak logo, or lettering styled after the Kodak wordmark.

The design precisely and unmistakably recalls a specific historical Kodak brand asset (e.g., the red "Kodak Express" oval, the yellow-and-red film box palette, or the iconic "K" logotype) in a way that a person familiar with Kodak's visual history would immediately identify as a deliberate heritage callback, not just generic use of red and yellow.

criteria.title: App-Icon Suitability
criteria.description: The primary mark is composed as a centered, square-friendly icon (e.g., rounded-square badge) appropriate for app-icon use rather than a wide horizontal lockup.

candidates.source: The SVG's root viewBox has a width-to-height ratio at or very close to 1:1 (square), rather than a wide horizontal rectangle.
The rendered screenshot shows the primary Kodak mark contained within a visually square or rounded-square badge shape rather than displayed as an elongated horizontal logotype.

The main graphical elements (icon mark and any text) are centered within the square canvas such that the composition would remain balanced and legible if cropped to an app-icon size, with no significant design elements positioned far to the left or right that would be cut off.

criteria.title: Balanced Square Composition
criteria.description: The main glyph is centered and proportionally balanced within its container shape, with even padding on all sides.

candidates.source: The rendered screenshot shows the main Kodak glyph/icon positioned at the visual center of its enclosing square or container shape, rather than skewed toward one side or corner.

Measuring the padding between the glyph and the edges of its container in the screenshot, the space on the left/right sides is roughly equal, and the space on the top/bottom sides is roughly equal, with no obviously uneven margins.

The SVG source defines the main glyph's coordinates and container shape such that the glyph's bounding box is mathematically centered within the container (equal horizontal and vertical offsets from each edge), and the rendered screenshot confirms this precise centering and symmetry with no perceptible deviation.

criteria.title: Minimal Clutter
criteria.description: The design avoids unnecessary decorative elements, gradients, or extraneous wordmark typography that clutter the minimalist look.

candidates.source: If the SVG source contains no <linearGradient>, <radialGradient>, or filter elements (e.g., drop shadows, blurs, glows) applied to the main logo shapes, return True; otherwise, return False.
If the rendered screenshot shows a design free of excessive decorative flourishes, textures, or busy background elements that distract from the core logo mark, return True; otherwise, return False.

If both the SVG source and rendered screenshot reflect a strictly minimal composition—using only simple flat vector shapes, at most one concise wordmark, and no superfluous ornamental or typographic elements beyond what is essential to convey the Kodak identity—return True; otherwise, return False.

criteria.title: Small-Size Legibility
criteria.description: The core mark remains clearly legible and distinct when scaled down to small sizes (e.g., favicon/app-icon scale).

candidates.source: The response's SVG root element includes a valid viewBox attribute, ensuring the design scales properly to small sizes such as favicons or app icons.

Based on the rendered screenshot, the core logo mark (shape, symbol, or wordmark) remains clearly recognizable and distinguishable from its background when mentally scaled down to a small icon size (e.g., 32x32 or 64x64 pixels).

Based on the rendered screenshot, the design avoids excessive fine detail, thin strokes, or small embedded text that would become illegible or blur together when rendered at favicon/app-icon scale, and any text elements are minimal or large enough to remain readable at that scale.

criteria.title: Letterform Quality
criteria.description: Any custom-drawn letterforms (e.g., K or Kodak wordmark) are well-proportioned, evenly spaced, and free of visual glitches or awkward strokes.

candidates.source: If the response includes any custom-drawn letterforms (e.g., a "K" or "Kodak" wordmark built from vector paths/shapes rather than a standard font rendering), these letterforms must be legible and clearly recognizable as their intended characters when viewed in the screenshots; otherwise, return False.

If the response contains custom-drawn letterforms, examine the screenshots closely for any visual glitches such as overlapping strokes, misaligned anchor points, broken or disconnected path segments, or inconsistent stroke widths; if any such glitches are present, return False, otherwise return True.

If the response contains a custom-drawn wordmark or letterform, strictly verify that letter spacing (kerning) is visually even and consistent across all characters, that stroke widths are uniform throughout each letterform, and that the overall proportions (height-to-width ratios) of each letter are balanced and professional-looking; return True only if all these conditions are met, otherwise return False.

criteria.title: High Contrast
criteria.description: There is strong color/value contrast between the mark and its background/container for clear visibility.

candidates.source: The rendered logo mark exhibits a clear, easily perceptible difference in color and/or value from its immediate background or container across the entire mark.
The contrast between the mark's colors (red/yellow) and the background is sufficient that the logo would remain distinguishable even if viewed in grayscale or at a glance.

Every element of the mark, including any fine details or small text, maintains strong contrast against its background with no low-contrast color pairings (e.g., yellow-on-white, light red-on-light background) that could reduce visibility.

criteria.title: Distinctive Modern Identity
criteria.description: The overall design feels like a deliberate, contemporary reinterpretation rather than a near-copy of the existing Kodak logo or a generic text lockup.

candidates.source: The rendered design must not be an exact or near-pixel replica of the current/historic Kodak logo (e.g., identical red rectangle with 'Kodak' wordmark in the same font, proportions, and layout).

The design should introduce at least one distinctive modern visual element (such as a novel shape, icon, gradient, or layout arrangement) beyond simply rendering the word 'Kodak' in a plain sans-serif font on a colored background.

Judged holistically from the screenshot, the logo should read as a thoughtful, original reinterpretation of Kodak's brand identity rather than a generic text lockup or a minor tweak of the existing logo.

criteria.title: No Overlap or Clipping Errors
criteria.description: Shapes and paths render cleanly without unintended overlaps, clipping, or misaligned elements.

candidates.source: If every shape and path in the rendered SVG appears fully contained within the viewBox with no element cropped or cut off at the edges, return True; otherwise, return False.

If the rendered logo shows no unintended overlapping of shapes (e.g., text obscured by background elements, icons colliding with letterforms) that detracts from legibility or visual clarity, return True; otherwise, return False.
If close visual inspection of the screenshot reveals any pixel-level misalignment, stray gaps, unintended overlaps, or clipped edges in any shape or path, return False; otherwise, return True.

criteria.title: Appropriate Canvas Framing
criteria.description: The viewBox dimensions and element placement avoid excessive empty space or awkward cropping of the design.

candidates.source: The SVG's viewBox dimensions produce an aspect ratio that closely matches the bounding box of the visible design elements, without large uniform margins of empty space on any side.
In the rendered screenshot, no part of the logo (text, icon, or graphic elements) appears cut off, clipped, or extending beyond the visible canvas edges.
The overall composition within the viewBox appears intentionally and proportionally framed, with the design neither cramped against the edges nor dwarfed by excessive surrounding whitespace.
